headline: ICICI Securities issues hold rating on JSW Infrastructure with Rs 326 target price

why_it_matters: Current holders get a target price reference for JSW Infrastructure

headline: JSW Infrastructure Q2 profit falls 12% to ₹318 crore
hook: Profit dips despite double-digit EBITDA growth
summary: JSW Infrastructure reported a 12% decline in net profit to ₹318 crore for the second quarter. Despite the bottom-line drop, the company achieved an 11% increase in EBITDA, reaching ₹674 crore. The firm maintains a net cash position of ₹1,693 crore against a gross debt of ₹7,292 crore. This performance reflects the company's current operational efficiency and debt management status.
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings miss may pressure stock price in near term

headline: JSW Infrastructure reports 11 percent drop in Q2 net profit
hook: Profit dips despite rising cargo volumes
summary: JSW Infrastructure posted a consolidated net profit of Rs 328.23 crore for the September quarter, down 11% from Rs 368.81 crore a year ago. Total income for the quarter stood at Rs 1,669.47 crore, while expenses increased to Rs 1,238.34 crore. Meanwhile, cargo volumes from Indian operations grew 8% year-on-year to 29.4 million tonnes. For Indian retail investors, the earnings highlight margin pressures despite steady operational volume growth in the port sector.
why_it_matters: Higher expenses pressure margins despite steady cargo volume growth

headline: Yuvraj Singh appointed as assistant and batting coach for Delhi Capitals
